name: Fund Settlement Parameters 3
definition: Parameters applied to the settlement of a security transfer.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date and time at which the securities are to be delivered or received.

SettlementPlace.name: Settlement Place
SettlementPlace.definition: Place where the settlement of transaction will take place. In the context of the investment funds, the place of settlement is the transfer agent, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place requested as the place of safekeeping.

SecuritiesSettlementSystemIdentification.name: Securities Settlement System Identification
SecuritiesSettlementSystemIdentification.definition: Identifies the securities settlement system to be used.

ReceivingSideDetails.name: Receiving Side Details
ReceivingSideDetails.definition: Chain of parties involved in the settlement of a transaction resulting in the movement of a security from one account to another.

DeliveringSideDetails.name: Delivering Side Details
DeliveringSideDetails.definition: Chain of parties involved in the settlement of a transaction resulting in the movement of a security from one account to another.
